howto: Hold down to tunnel into the mountain and break ore into your hold.
Climb back to the surface: the hold sells itself and the rig patches up.
Watch the storm ring: wind shear drops debris and the typhoon floods your tunnels.
When the Eye passes over, hazards stop and every ore is worth double.
Spend your bank in the surface shop: drill, hold, pumps, roof supports, lightning rod and lamp.
tips: Dig in the CALM, be near the top when the TYPHOON lands, and dive again for the EYE.
In a typhoon the flood climbs almost to the surface; each Flood pumps level holds the water 5 m lower.
Falling debris stops at the first solid rock: when the wind builds, tunnel sideways under cover.
Roof supports soften debris and lightning hits and give you a little more warning.
Being carried out keeps your bank and upgrades; you only lose half of the ore you were holding.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to tunnel and climb. Space or Enter starts from the title. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Hold the on-screen pad arrows, or drag on the mine in the direction to dig. Tap a shop row to buy.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title: Easy has the storm throw less and hit softer, Hard throws more debris and bolts and hits harder. Every storm cycle also gets longer and rougher, and the rock gets harder with depth.

cheats.effect: Debris, lightning and drowning cannot hurt you
The storm clock holds at CALM
The lamp lights the whole mine

features.difficulty: Easy / Normal / Hard buttons on the title; each storm cycle is longer and rougher than the last
features.power-up-list: The surface rig shop lists all six upgrades with level, effect and price
features.wave-or-level-counter: The HUD names the storm you are in and its phase (STORM 2 - TYPHOON); the ring counts down each phase
features.high-score-table: Best hauls: the top five loads you sold, with depth and date, on the title, beside deepest and storms weathered
features.results: Being carried out opens a results card: this dive's depth, ore lost, bank and deepest, with Dig again
features.tutorial: First dive: four prompts (tunnel down, break ore, sell at the surface, upgrade), each cleared by doing it; Skip, and Replay tutorial in How to play
features.hints: Hint reads the storm phase, the flood, your hold and your bank
